title: Apply for an RSA competency card (NSW RSA bridging applicants)
summary: This page outlines the steps and requirements for NSW RSA bridging applicants to obtain a competency card.
intro:
Before applying for a NSW RSA competency card you must complete an online NSW RSA bridging course if you:

Once you successfully complete the course, you will need to visit a Service NSW Centre to apply for your competency card.

You must submit your own application in person – other people can’t apply for you.

### Working temporarily in NSW

If you hold a current interstate RSA certification you may be able to work temporarily in NSW. For information or to see if you are eligible go to Liquor & Gaming NSW RSA Bridging course.

For up-to-date information, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW: Training.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor and gaming training contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: Applicants from Victoria, ACT, or Northern Territory must have a national RSA Statement of Attainment or RSA refresher certificate issued within the last 3 years.
Applicants from Queensland, South Australia, Western Australia, or Tasmania must have a national RSA Statement of Attainment issued within the last 5 years.
what_you_need: Payment for the online NSW RSA bridging course.
NSW RSA bridging course completion certificate issued by Liquor & Gaming NSW.
Current interstate RSA certificate issued by an approved training provider.
100 points of ID documents (acceptable types are listed on the back of your course completion certificate).
Australian marriage certificate (Registry issued) or overseas marriage certificate (with official translation).
Change of name certificate (Registry issued) or proof of divorce (Family Court).
If your name has changed, you must provide proof of the name change.

how_to_steps.text: Complete the online NSW RSA bridging course to get your course completion certificate. This certificate is not an interim certificate and does not allow you to serve alcohol in licensed venues in NSW.
Visit a Service NSW Centre to have your photo taken and apply for your competency card.

You will get an RSA bridging course interim certificate after you've applied for your competency card. The interim certificate allows you to work in relevant roles for 90 days from the date of issue. After that time you must use your competency card.
The cost of the competency card is included in the fee you pay for the RSA bridging course.
Your photo competency card will be mailed to your nominated address within 5 weeks of submitting your application.
Once you have your competency card you can add it to the Service NSW app and access it on your device.

faqs.q: Do I need to apply for the competency card in person?
faqs.a: Yes, you must submit your application in person at a Service NSW Centre. Other people cannot apply for you.

faqs.q: What is the first step to getting the competency card?
faqs.a: You must first complete an online NSW RSA bridging course to receive a course completion certificate.

faqs.q: How long is the interim certificate valid?
faqs.a: After applying for your competency card, you will receive an interim certificate that allows you to work in relevant roles for 90 days. After this time, you must use your competency card.
